verdict.rationale: Docs confirm rich editor building blocks—collapsible/toggled headings, inline LaTeX, bookmarks/embeds, and a composable block system (text, databases, kanban, calendar) plus community confirmation of basic tables—supporting much of the story. However, there is no explicit documentation of callout blocks, code blocks, or keyboard-shortcut/keyboard-driven navigation, and no hands-on evidence of editor speed. Missing for 10: explicit callout block support, code block/syntax highlighting evidence, and documented keyboard-shortcut-driven workflow.
